title: Ash Ember Kitchen: Wood Fired Street Food in Sparks, NV
meta_description: Wood fired tacos, bowls, and catering from a family run truck in Sparks, Nevada. Find us tonight or book us for your event.
headline: Cooked over real fire, served out a window.
subhead: A family run truck slinging wood fired tacos, rice bowls, and late night plates. Find us parked around Sparks, or book the truck for your own party.
services_intro: Five things, made the same way every night. When the fire is out, we are out.

services.name: Wood fired tacos
services.description: Three to an order, handmade tortillas, charred over mesquite.

services.name: Fire bowls
services.description: Rice, beans, grilled protein, salsa roja, and whatever came in fresh.

services.name: Late plates
services.description: Bigger portions for after the shift or after the show.

services.name: Family packs
services.description: Feeds four to six, ready in twenty minutes when you call ahead.

services.name: Event catering
services.description: We park, we cook, your guests eat all night. Twenty to three hundred people.

services.name: Private buyouts
services.description: The whole truck for your block party, wedding, or work event.

about_heading: One truck, one family, one fire.
about_body: We started with a borrowed grill at a farmers market and a recipe that came off a grandmother's stove. Six years later the same family is still on the line.
Everything is cooked to order over mesquite. That is slower than a fryer and it is the whole point.

reviews.text: Best tacos in Sparks, and it is not close. The char on the meat is unreal.
They catered our wedding for a hundred and twenty people and every single guest asked about them.
I work nights and this is the only place worth stopping for at midnight.

contact_heading: Find us, or bring us to you.
